primitives.name: Community Partnership Strength
primitives.verbatim_quote: National Science Foundation (NSF) National Solar Observatory (NSO) scientists, educators and public outreach officers organizing an eclipse viewing party at a sports complex stadium on the US/Mexico border in Eagle Pass, TX in collaboration with educators from Eagle Pass and Uvalde areas.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'Strength of partnership (dimensionless normalized score)', 'C': 'Community engagement coefficient (unitless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Partnership strength scales linearly with number of collaborating institutions and local educator involvement.

layer2.mapping: The GSI Bayesian model maps S as a latent variable derived from C and institutional collaboration indices.
layer2.telemetry: Number of participating institutions × average educator engagement score

primitives.name: Public Engagement Spatial Density
primitives.verbatim_quote: On the day of the eclipse, we set up activities at the Eagle Pass Student Activity Center (SAC) football stadium, welcoming students and the public from surrounding areas to experience the eclipse with us.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D': 'Spatial density of public engagement (people/km²)', 'A': 'Stadium area (km²)', 'N': 'Total attendees (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Attendee distribution is uniform within stadium boundary.

layer2.mapping: GSE state transition engine uses D to adjust real-time resource allocation and safety protocols.
layer2.telemetry: Real-time GPS tracking of attendee movement and crowd density estimation

primitives.name: Volunteer Efficiency Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: We were supported by up to 33 undergraduate student volunteers from both Sul Ross State University's (SRSU) Robert Noyce En La Frontera Scholarship Program and Southwest Texas Junior College (SWTJC) in Uvalde, building upon relationships established ahead of and during the October 2023 annular eclipse in Uvalde, TX.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E': 'Efficiency index (dimensionless)', 'V': 'Number of volunteers (dimensionless)', 'T': 'Training hours per volunteer (hours)'}
primitives.assumptions: Efficiency increases logarithmically with training time and decreases with task complexity.

layer2.mapping: GSI probabilistic model treats E as a function of V and T to predict operational success rate.
layer2.telemetry: Average volunteer task completion time and feedback scores
